_about: Advisories the CI dependency audit (npm run deps:check) allows for a dated window. Each one names one advisory and the package npm reports it on, cites an owner decision recorded under docs/decisions/, and expires at most 92 days after it was decided. It also stops applying as soon as npm reports a fix that needs no major upgrade. Rules: scripts/lib/auditGate.mjs. Remove an entry by hand once npm no longer reports its advisory; the check prints a warning when that happens.

exceptions.reason: Renewed from D53 (2026-10-03 to 2026-11-03). No patched braces release exists: 3.0.3, published 2024-09-18, is the newest, and the advisory covers every version. braces now comes in only through eslint-config-next 16.3.8 (via @next/eslint-plugin-next, fast-glob and micromatch); Tailwind 4 no longer depends on it (2026-10-07). It runs on ESLint's file globs, written in this repo, and no visitor input reaches it. npm's suggested fix is eslint-config-next 14.2.35, a major downgrade.
